intro: The Dominican Republic is a presidential democracy.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years; Luis Abinader was re-elected in 2024. Congress has a Senate and a Chamber of Deputies.

chapters.title: Relations with Haiti
text: Migration and the border with Haiti are major political issues.
